record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, Altaschith<WH0516><WTH8686>, A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>or<Fi> Song<WH07892> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> Unto thee, O God<WH0430>, do we give thanks<WH03034><WTH8689>, <FI>unto thee<Fi> do we give thanks<WH03034><WTH8689>: for <FI>that<Fi> thy name<WH08034> is near<WH07138> thy wondrous works<WH06381><WTH8737> declare<WH05608><WTH8765>. <RF>Altaschith: or, Destroy not<Rf> <RF>of: or, for<Rf>
When I shall receive<WH03947><WTH8799> the congregation<WH04150> I will judge<WH08199><WTH8799> uprightly<WH04339>. <RF>receive...: or, take a set time<Rf>
The earth<WH0776> and all the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> thereof are dissolved<WH04127><WTH8737>: I bear up<WH08505><WTH8765> the pillars<WH05982> of it. Selah<WH05542>.
I said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto the fools<WH01984><WTH8802>, Deal not foolishly<WH01984><WTH8799>: and to the wicked<WH07563>, Lift not up<WH07311><WTH8686> the horn<WH07161>:
Lift not up<WH07311><WTH8686> your horn<WH07161> on high<WH04791>: speak<WH01696><WTH8762> <FI>not with<Fi> a stiff<WH06277> neck<WH06677>.<CM>
For promotion<WH07311><WTH8687><WTH8676><WH02022> <FI>cometh<Fi> neither from the east<WH04161>, nor from the west<WH04628>, nor from the south<WH04057>. <RF>south: Heb. desert<Rf>
But God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> the judge<WH08199><WTH8802>: he putteth down<WH08213><WTH8686> one, and setteth up<WH07311><WTH8686> another.

For in the hand<WH03027> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>there is<Fi> a cup<WH03563>, and the wine<WH03196> is red<WH02560><WTH8804>; it is full<WH04392> of mixture<WH04538>; and he poureth out<WH05064><WTH8686> of the same<WH02088>: but the dregs<WH08105> thereof, all the wicked<WH07563> of the earth<WH0776> shall wring <FI>them<Fi> out<WH04680><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> drink<WH08354><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> .
But I will declare<WH05046><WTH8686> for ever<WH05769>; I will sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> to the God<WH0430> of Jacob<WH03290>.
All the horns<WH07161> of the wicked<WH07563> also will I cut off<WH01438><WTH8762>; <FI>but<Fi> the horns<WH07161> of the righteous<WH06662> shall be exalted<WH07311><WTH8783>.<CM>
